clauses.clause: Continue review is eligible when portfolioScore is at least 60 and reviewerCapacity is at least 1.
Archive application is eligible only when legalHold is false.
Technical interview is eligible only for Continue review, portfolioScore at least 75, and technicalSlots at least 1.
Recruiter screen is eligible only for Continue review and recruiterSlots at least 1.
Skills gap is eligible only for Archive application and assessmentCount at least 1.
Role closed is eligible only for Archive application and openRoleCount exactly 0. Both archive reasons may be eligible at once; the user chooses one.
A fresh, changed-entity, or changed-published-revision input clears all transient selections, confirmation, and receipt.
A different eligible root clears detail and confirmation; reselecting the same root is idempotent.
A different eligible detail clears confirmation; confirmation toggles only when root and detail are valid.
Same-pair replacement preserves valid state/receipt, invalidates root before detail, updates display, and emits no business callback.
Successful enabled recording emits one exact ordered event, then visibly records and disables all interaction; other successful taps are quiet.
Full caller text, exact summary/status branches and exact receipt text remain displayed after real actions and caller updates.
The real component uses opaque designed surface/primary/first-row fills, visible selected check, and supported control-box height.
Typography follows the independent 24/15 system type intent. Android available text layout is precise; iOS uses the explicit visual hierarchy/wrapping proposition.
Real production API is exactly the immutable input and View/composable signature in API.md.
Actual bridge only decodes the fixture, applies the stock Android theme, and passes the same callback to the real component.
Actual additive production placement/product/package and bridge-to-production call match API.md.

scope: Semantic index into the sealed atomic denominators and three required source-review duties. No source or native actual is approved.
